title: Adaptive Domain Decomposition for Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.05659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we present adaptive domain decomposition finite basis physics-informed neural networks (ADD-FBPINNs). The proposed method integrates Partition of Unity Networks (POUNets), a data-driven approach for learning domain partitions, with finite Basis physics-informed neural networks (FBPINNs) to perform more efficient domain decomposition and achieve more accurate approximations. FBPINNs improve upon the accuracy of standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) through user-defined subdivisions of the computational domain. By adapting the domain decomposition based on the solution's features using a separable POUNet, the framework can automatically learn partitions that are stable and can be geometrically interpretable. translated_title: 有限基物理信息神经网络的自适应域分解
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了自适应域分解有限基物理信息神经网络（ADD-FBPINNs）。所提出的方法将单位分解网络（POUNets）——一种用于学习域划分的数据驱动方法——与有限基物理信息神经网络（FBPINNs）相结合，以实现更高效的域分解并获得更精确的逼近。FBPINNs通过用户自定义的计算域细分来提高标准物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的精度。通过使用可分离的POUNet根据解的特征自适应地调整域分解，该框架能够自动学习稳定且在几何上可解释的划分。我们在二维亥姆霍兹方程、具有多尺度特征的二维泊松方程以及粘性Burgers方程上测试了该方法，观察到与固定域分解的FBPINNs相比精度有所提升。
tldr: 本文提出ADD-FBPINNs方法，将数据驱动的单位分解网络与有限基物理信息神经网络相结合，能够根据解的特征自动学习稳定且几何可解释的自适应域分解，在多个偏微分方程求解任务上相比固定域分解的FBPINNs获得更高精度。
